list.title: Invitation codes
list.subtitle: What opens the reserved modules of Guide Négo. A code travels through a WhatsApp group, copied by hand: it is shared, never personal.
list.caption: Guide Négo invitation codes, most recent first.

forbidden.scope: Administer Guide Négo, across the whole platform
forbidden.description: Invitation codes, access requests and the admission mode are reserved for platform-wide administrators. An account scoped to a single event has no access to them.

filters.label: List filters
filters.search: Search a code or a label
filters.shown: {shown} code shown of {total} | {shown} code shown of {total} | {shown} codes shown of {total}

empty.title: No invitation code
empty.description: Nobody can enter the reserved modules yet. Create a code, then share it with the group concerned.

noResults.title: No matching code
noResults.description: None of the {total} codes match these filters.

form.title: Create an invitation code
form.subtitle: The code is generated by the platform: eight characters, without the letters and digits that look alike.

label.label: Label
label.hint: What will make it findable in the list: the group, the workshop, the network.

scope.label: What the code opens
scope.hint: One negotiation space, or all of Guide Négo.

network.label: Network membership
network.hint: Optional. Membership comes from the code used, and from nothing else.

maxUses.label: Number of entries
maxUses.hint: Leave empty for an unlimited code.

validFrom.label: Opens on
validFrom.hint: Leave empty to open right away.

validUntil.label: Closes on
validUntil.hint: Leave empty for a code with no end date.

created.title: Code created
created.description: Share it with the group concerned. It stays readable in the list.

error.label: Give the code a label.
error.max_uses: The number of entries must be greater than zero.
error.valid_until: The closing date must come after the opening date.

detail.title: Code {code}
detail.grantedUses: {count} access still open | {count} access still open | {count} accesses still open

uses.title: Who entered with this code
uses.caption: People who entered with this code, open accesses first.

empty.title: Nobody has entered yet
empty.description: This code has not opened any access so far.

notFound.title: Code not found
notFound.description: This invitation code does not exist, or it has been deleted.

revoke.title: Revoke this code?
revoke.question: The code will stop opening from the next attempt on.
revoke.keeps: The {count} access already granted stays open: revoking it is a separate action. | The {count} access already granted stays open: revoking it is a separate action. | The {count} accesses already granted stay open: revoking them is a separate action.
revoke.keepsNone: This code has not granted any access yet.
revoke.reasonHint: What you write here will be read by the next person who opens this record.

revokeAccess.title: Revoke {name}'s access?
revokeAccess.question: The reserved modules will close at their next opening of the app.

revokeAll.title: Revoke every access from this code?
revokeAll.question: The {count} person who entered with this code will lose their access. | The {count} person who entered with this code will lose their access. | The {count} people who entered with this code will lose their access.
revokeAll.warning: This follows a code leak: it does not replace revoking the code, it completes it.

result.accessAlreadyRevoked: This access had already been revoked.
result.allRevoked: {count} access revoked. | {count} access revoked. | {count} accesses revoked.
result.noneRevoked: No access to revoke: they had all already been closed.
